import ast, re
src = open("api.py", encoding="utf-8").read()
fn = [n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(src)) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "fetch_user"]
assert fn
d = ast.get_docstring(fn[0])
assert d and re.search(r"[぀-ヿ一-鿿]", d), d
from api import fetch_user
for u in [0, 3, 42, "abc", None, -1]:
    assert fetch_user(u) == {"id": u}, u
print("ok")

note: fetch_user has Japanese docstring and same behavior on various ids
